name: Yuuki Tomosane
source:
Tomosane is the protagonist of the "Jabberwocky I & II" chapters. He is considered to be the strongest fist-fighter in the school and he rules over its most unsavory elements by fear. Tomosane is also a source of dread for [url=https://vndb.org/c3560]Takuji[/url], whom he brutalizes and extorts money from frequently. Other than that, [spoiler]he works part-time as a piano player at a transvestite bar, and has a tumultuous friendship with [url=https://vndb.org/c3565]Minakami Yuki[/url][/spoiler]. His secret hobby is playing retro video games.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wonderful_Everyday]Wikipedia[/url]]
